faqs.question: What does the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Hair measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of fungal infections in hair samples.

faqs.question: Why is the Fungal Culture and Identification test - Hair done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose fungal infections in the hair • To provide appropriate antifungal treatment • To monitor the effectiveness of antifungal treatment • To identify specific fungal species causing the infection

faqs.question: When is the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Hair recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended for individuals who • exhibit symptoms such as persistent scalp itching, scaling, or hair loss, • have a suspected fungal infection based on their medical history or physical examination, or • require treatment with antifungal medication for a diagnosed fungal infection.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Hair are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate the presence of a fungal infection in the hair.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Fungal Culture and Identification test - Hair?
faqs.answer: During this test, a healthcare professional will collect a sample of your hair in a sterile, leak-proof container. They will send your hair sample to the laboratory for analysis using automated MALDITOF technology.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Fungal Culture and Identification Test - Hair?
faqs.answer: • Follow any specific instructions provided by your doctor. • Inform your doctor if you have any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the Fungal Culture and Identification Test- Hair?
faqs.answer: • KOH (Potassium Hydroxide) preparation: This test helps visualise fungal elements under a microscope. • Histopathology: This test examines hair samples under a microscope to identify fungal infections.

faqs.question: What is the Fungal Culture and Identification Test- Hair also known as?
faqs.answer: Hair Fungal Culture and Identification or Hair Mycology

faqs.question: What is the significance of diagnosing fungal infections in hair?
faqs.answer: Fungal infections in hair can lead to various conditions such as scalp ringworm (tinea capitis) or fungal folliculitis. Accurate diagnosis through tests helps ensure appropriate treatment and prevents further complications.
